title: Quick & Dirty DNA Extraction
author: Sam Mantel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.baf7ibrn
materials: Allow solution to cool to room temperature.
Recap tubes and invert several times to mix.
Slowly pour off supernatant without disturbing pelleted DNA.

steps.title: Prepare Quick & Dirty Extraction Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the extraction buffer by combining reagents in a 1 L glass bottle with a stir bar.

substeps.instruction: Add roughly 200 mL nanopure H2O to the bottle and stir.
Transfer 80 mL 1 M Tris base to the bottle.
Transfer 56 mL 0.5 M EDTA to the bottle.
Transfer 46.7 g NaCl to the bottle.
Transfer 3 g sodium metabisulfite to the bottle.
Return the bottle to the autoclave for 00:25:00.
Transfer the solution to a graduated cylinder and add nanopure H2O to bring the total volume to 400 mL.
Gently add 100 mL 5% sarkosyl solution to the buffer (pour slowly to avoid foaming).
Swirl the solution gently to mix. Note: Do not autoclave after adding detergent.

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Equipment
steps.instruction: Pre-heat the buffer and chill the washing solvents.

substeps.instruction: Pre-heat the Quick & Dirty extraction buffer with detergent in a 60 °C incubator.
Place isopropanol, 70% ethanol, and 95% ethanol in the freezer to chill.

steps.title: Prepare Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare the frozen tissue samples for homogenization.

substeps.instruction: Place one steel ball bearing into each sample tube.
Remove the plate from -80 °C, quickly remove the bottom from the plate, and float in liquid nitrogen to keep tissue frozen.
Open tubes and discard caps.

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue
steps.instruction: Grind the tissue into a fine powder using a homogenizer.

substeps.instruction: Snap the bottom back on to the plate and shake in a tissue homogenizer for 00:00:30 on the highest speed. Note: Shake without a lid so the casing holds caps in place; distribute samples evenly across the plate.
Once tissue is ground to a fine powder, centrifuge briefly to remove powder from the inside of the caps.

steps.title: Extract DNA
steps.instruction: Lysis and incubation of the homogenized tissue.

substeps.instruction: Add 350 µL pre-heated Q&D extraction buffer with detergent to each sample.
Incubate samples at 60 °C for 00:15:00 to 01:00:00. Note: To prevent caps from popping, place an inverted plate bottom over caps and hold down with a weight.
Centrifuge at 3700 rpm, 22 °C for 20 minutes to pellet tissue.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Isolate the DNA from the supernatant using isopropanol.

substeps.instruction: Near the end of the previous spin, transfer 200 µL per sample of ice-cold isopropanol to a new plate.
Transfer 300 µL (or as much as possible) of supernatant from each sample to the isopropanol plate.
Add 150 µL 1 M ammonium acetate to each sample.
Cover with clean caps and invert gently to mix.
Invert samples gently every 00:05:00. Note: Ensure tubes are closed completely before inverting.
Incubate at room temperature for 00:05:00 to 00:15:00.
Centrifuge at 3700 rpm, 4 °C for 20 minutes to pellet DNA.

steps.title: Wash and Purify DNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Perform sequential ethanol washes to clean the DNA pellet.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL ice-cold 70% ethanol to each sample.
Cover with clean caps and invert gently to mix.
Centrifuge at 3700 rpm, 4 °C for 10 minutes to wash pellet.
Add 500 µL ice-cold 95% ethanol to each sample.
Cover with clean caps and invert gently to mix.
Centrifuge at 3700 rpm, 4 °C for 5 minutes to wash pellet.

steps.title: Dry and Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet and resuspend in a suitable buffer.

substeps.instruction: Place the flat on a paper towel and cover the open tubes with a KimWipe.
Once the pellet is dry and no residual liquid remains, re-suspend pellets with 20 µL - 100 µL of TE buffer or nanopure H2O depending on pellet size, desired concentration, and future uses.
